name: Alfra Ray
source:
Alfra Ray is a girl protected by the Revolutionary Group of the Magic Kingdom of Zeth, Ice Flame, in the orphanage ran by [url=/c98811]Kimchi Drive[/url]. She was usually accompanied by [url=/c98810]Karma Atranger[/url] or Kimchi herself, being a very timid and easily frightened little girl.  

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Alfra_Ray]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
